verification_questions.question: A deliberate port-3100 collision test (e.g. background serve on 3100 before `make e2e`) leaves zero orphan processes and teardown exits cleanly with no manual intervention.
The reproduction test fails before the fix and passes after.
assertPortFree(3100) is called before any bunker or serve spawns.
serve is spawned in detached mode and the actual child pid is recorded for teardown (no npx parent-child split).
On setup abort (port occupied), .state.json is absent or consistent — no partial bunker PIDs without serve PID.
